blocker.message: The return obligations universally quantify cap_Class_pre and destTask_Prio_pre independently of cap_Class and destTask_Prio. Without equality bridges, current bounds cannot establish the required pre-variable bounds and ownership at current table/slot addresses cannot entail ownership at the pre-variable addresses; all three split goals for return_wit_1 and both whole return VCs are therefore unprovable.
blocker.repair_boundary: Repair the ucos_Grant_Cap return annotation/contract so the relevant exits preserve cap_Class_pre = cap_Class and destTask_Prio_pre = destTask_Prio (or equivalent facts) in the generated obligations, then regenerate the formal files.
